purpose: Resolve over-broad legal validations before using source documents for procedural routing.

corrections.prior_risk: Previous draft test said signal against authority must never go to that authority for resolution.
corrections.verified_rule: Сигналите не могат да се решават от лицето/органа, срещу чиито действия са подадени, ОСВЕН ако приемат сигнала за основателен и го уважат.
corrections.test_positive: If target authority itself considers signal justified and fully grants it, statutory exception may apply; verify actual authority and procedural evidence.
corrections.test_negative: Otherwise resolve at appropriate superior/controlling authority; no self-rejection.

corrections.prior_risk: Prior draft characterized EO report + consultation records as universally mandatory for every art.23 request.
corrections.verified_rule: Standard route art.23(1): full EO report and consultation documentation; art.23(2) for cases under art.3(3) uses copy of ecological part of plan/program as a special accompanying document.
corrections.test_positive: When art.3(3) is proved, use statutory art.23(2) dossier; don't falsely demand full standard bundle without checking paragraph.
corrections.test_negative: Ordinary art.23(1) route still requires complete documentation including consultation results.

corrections.verified_rule: Noncompliant/uncomplete application under al.1 returned within seven days with instructions; do not invent an arbitrary universal remedy or assume automatic favorable statement.
corrections.test_positive: Incomplete standard statement request -> return with instructions within prescribed seven days.

corrections.verified_rule: Competent organ issues opinion within 30 days from art.23(1) request on the basis of a decision of committee/expert ecological council per art.5(1); any documented extensions/checks must be applied case-specifically.
corrections.test_positive: Proceed to opinion only after competent collegial mechanism and procedural dossier.

corrections.legal: Наредба ЕО чл.12 ал.1–4 и чл.13 ал.1–2
corrections.verified_rule: Art.12 screening-request completeness check within 7 days; response period for Ministry of Health/RZI consultations up to 14 days; optional local/specialized bodies up to 7 days. Missing information period excluded from art.85(5) ZOOS clock.
corrections.test_positive: Do not conflate 7 day document check, 14 day health opinions, 7 day optional opinions, or statutory decision deadline.

corrections.verified_rule: If organ under art.119(2) refuses to consider signal justified, sends signal + explanation to higher authority within one month of its submission and notifies submitter; distinguish from art.112 wrong-competence forwarding.
corrections.test_positive: Target organ rejects merits -> one-month escalation path, not dismiss as already resolved.

corrections.verified_rule: Chapter eight not applicable when law provides another procedure for the proposals/signals; objection and complaint require independent classification.
corrections.test_positive: Special law prioritized; not merge appeal, objection and proposal to generic suggestions/signals.

changes_requested_to_prior_QA.notes: Interpret test APK_SIGNAL_CONFLICT as exception-aware (art113); EO_OPINION_WITHOUT_REPORT as art23(1) default with art23(2) alternate.
Add exceptions as explicit validation gates for 12 and 18; 22 route count remains unchanged.

new_regression_tests.expected: Alternative statutory dossier when art3(3) holds
Seven-day return with instructions for incomplete art23(1) request
Target authority may grant justified signal without violating no-self-resolution rule
One-month handoff upon unfavorable self-assessment by authority named in signal
